{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"N.A."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field states \"N.A.\" while note N3 specifies case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a case depth of 0.8–1.2 mm, creating a direct contradiction that could cause the part to be shipped without required hardening. The designer must change the title block heat treatment field to reference note N3 or state the actual treatment."
  , "recommended_correction": "Update the title block 'heat_treatment' field from 'N.A.' to reference note N3 or explicitly state 'CASE HARDENED 55-60 HRC, DEPTH 0.8-1.2mm' so the requirement is unambiguous on the drawing."}]}
